reg_deadline.en: Registration closed Tuesday, October 13, 2026. Kansas has no same-day or Election Day registration.
reg_deadline.es: El registro cerró el martes 13 de octubre de 2026. Kansas no tiene registro el mismo día ni el Día de las Elecciones.
reg_deadline.quote: October 13 Deadline to register to vote or update your voter registration to change address or name only to participate in the 2026 general election.

mail_request.en: Applications for a ballot by mail had to reach your county election office by Tuesday, October 27. You can still vote early in person at your county election office or a satellite site until noon Monday, November 2.
mail_request.es: Las solicitudes de boleta por correo tenían que llegar a la oficina electoral de tu condado a más tardar el martes 27 de octubre. Todavía puedes votar por anticipado en persona en la oficina electoral de tu condado o en un lugar satélite hasta el mediodía del lunes 2 de noviembre.
mail_request.quote: for the general election occurring on the Tuesday following the first Monday in November in both even-numbered and odd-numbered years, between 90 days prior to such election and the Tuesday of the week preceding such general election
mail_request.en_after: Applications for a ballot by mail are closed. Vote at your polling place on Election Day.
mail_request.es_after: Las solicitudes de boleta por correo ya cerraron. Vota en tu lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones.

mail_return.en: Drop your ballot at your county election office, an authorized drop box or a polling place before polls close on Tuesday, November 3, and it counts. Mailing it? The Secretary of State says a court order covers this election: mailed ballots postmarked by Election Day count if they arrive by the last mail delivery on Friday, November 6. Kansas law without that order requires arrival by the close of polls, so mail it early.
mail_return.es: Deja tu boleta en la oficina electoral de tu condado, en un buzón autorizado o en un lugar de votación antes de que cierren las casillas el martes 3 de noviembre, y cuenta. ¿La vas a mandar por correo? La Secretaría de Estado dice que una orden judicial cubre esta elección: las boletas por correo con matasellos del Día de las Elecciones cuentan si llegan con la última entrega de correo del viernes 6 de noviembre. Sin esa orden, la ley de Kansas exige que llegue antes del cierre de las casillas, así que mándala con tiempo.
mail_return.quote: A district court in Douglas County entered a statewide injunction requiring ballots postmarked by election day to be counted if a ballot arrives by the last postal delivery on Friday after the election.
mail_return.notes: Same SOS page, Oct 26: 'Under Kansas statute, the deadline to return your ballot is the close of the polls on Election Day.' ... 'the Secretary of State filed a renewed motion with the Court of Appeals after the Primary asking it to stay the injunction for purposes of the General Election. The motion was denied.' The page's later sentence ('Beginning in 2026, all mail ballots must be received ... by close of polls') states the statute, which the injunction overrides for this election. Re-read before Nov 3 in case a higher court rules. Earlier note (Oct 21): CONFLICT on the same SOS page (sos.ks.gov/elections/advance-voting-information.html). Quote 1: 'A district court in Douglas County entered a statewide injunction requiring ballots postmarked by election day to be counted if a ballot arrives by the last postal delivery on Friday after the election. ... the Secretary of State filed a renewed motion with the Court of Appeals after the Primary asking it to stay the injunction for purposes of the General Election. The motion was denied.' Quote 2: 'Beginning in 2026, all mail ballots must be received in the county election office, authorized drop box, or polling place by close of polls on Election day to be counted. Voters will no longer have a 3-day grace period for their ballot to arrive.' The dates page and voter information page repeat quote 2; the Elections 101 PDF still shows the old 3-day grace period.

early_hours.en: Each county sets its own advance voting times and places, so check with your county election office. Every county must start in-person advance voting by Tuesday, October 27, and it ends at noon on Monday, November 2.
early_hours.es: Cada condado decide sus horarios y lugares de votación anticipada, así que consulta con la oficina electoral de tu condado. Todos los condados deben empezar la votación anticipada en persona a más tardar el martes 27 de octubre, y termina al mediodía del lunes 2 de noviembre.
early_hours.quote: Unless an earlier date is designated by the county election office, applications for advance voting ballots transmitted to the voter in person shall be filed on the Tuesday next preceding the election and on each subsequent business day until no later than 12:00 noon on the day preceding such election.
early_hours.en_after: In-person advance voting ended at noon on November 2. Vote at your polling place on Election Day.
early_hours.es_after: La votación anticipada en persona terminó al mediodía del 2 de noviembre. Vota en tu lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones.

cure.notes: The SOS FAQ says the county contacts the voter about a signature mismatch (used in mail.cure) but gives no deadline.

in_person.en: Before Election Day, you can advance vote in person at your county election office or a satellite voting site, starting as early as 20 days before the election. On Election Day, vote at your polling place.
in_person.es: Antes del Día de las Elecciones puedes votar por anticipado en persona en la oficina electoral de tu condado o en un centro de votación satélite, desde 20 días antes de la elección. El Día de las Elecciones, vota en tu lugar de votación.
in_person.quote: State law allows in-person advance voting to begin up to 20 days before election day at county election offices or satellite voting locations. All counties must offer in-person advance voting no later than one week before election day.

first_time.notes: Kansas has no same-day registration (dates.reg_deadline). The FAQ's moved-after-the-deadline rule (vote at your old precinct and fill out a new registration) is not a first-time-voter rule, so it is not used here.

rule.en: Use VoterView to find your polling place, check your registration and track your mail ballot.
rule.es: Usa VoterView para encontrar tu lugar de votación, revisar tu registro y dar seguimiento a tu boleta por correo.
rule.quote: Confirm your address, party association, mail-in ballot statuses, and polling place locations.

en: Driver's license or nondriver ID card from Kansas or another state
ID card from a Native American tribe
Employee badge or ID from a city, county, state or federal government office
Student ID from an accredited college or university in Kansas
Concealed carry license from Kansas or another state
Public assistance ID card from a government office
es: Licencia de conducir o identificación para no conductores de Kansas o de otro estado
Identificación de una tribu nativa americana
Credencial o identificación de empleado de una oficina de gobierno municipal, de condado, estatal o federal
Identificación de estudiante de una universidad acreditada en Kansas
Licencia de portación oculta de armas (concealed carry license) de Kansas o de otro estado
Tarjeta de identificación de asistencia pública de una oficina de gobierno
accepted.quote: State law requires Kansas voters to show photographic identification when casting a vote in person. The following documents may be used to meet photo ID requirements for voting:

expired.en: If your ID has an expiration date, it can't be expired when you vote. If you're 65 or older, an expired photo ID works.
expired.es: Si tu identificación tiene fecha de vencimiento, no puede estar vencida cuando votes. Si tienes 65 años o más, sirve una identificación con foto vencida.
expired.quote: If the photo ID has an expiration date on it, the ID must not have expired at the time of voting.

without.en: Forgot your ID? You'll vote a provisional ballot. It's only valid once you get your photo ID to the county election office before the county canvass, so ask your county for that date. Some voters don't need a photo ID: permanent advance voters, military and overseas voters and their families, and voters with a religious objection who sign a Declaration of Religious Objection.
without.es: ¿Olvidaste tu identificación? Votarás con una boleta provisional. Solo es válida cuando llevas tu identificación con foto a la oficina electoral de tu condado antes del escrutinio del condado (county canvass), así que pregunta en tu condado cuál es esa fecha. Algunos votantes no necesitan identificación con foto: los votantes anticipados permanentes, los votantes militares y en el extranjero y sus familias, y quienes tienen una objeción religiosa y firman una Declaración de Objeción Religiosa (Declaration of Religious Objection).
without.quote: The provisional ballot will not be considered valid until the voter submits their photographic identification to before the county canvass. ... Exemptions from photo ID requirements exist for: permanent advance voters (voters with illness or disabilities); military and overseas voters and their spouses and dependents; and voter with religious objections who sign a Declaration of Religious Objection (Form DRO).

who.en: Any Kansas voter can vote by mail, no excuse needed. Most voters apply for a mail ballot for each election, with a driver's license number or a copy of a photo ID. If you have a permanent disability or a permanent illness, you can apply once for permanent advance voting status.
who.es: Cualquier votante de Kansas puede votar por correo sin dar una razón. La mayoría pide una boleta por correo para cada elección, con el número de su licencia de conducir o una copia de una identificación con foto. Si tienes una discapacidad permanente o una enfermedad permanente, puedes pedir una sola vez el estatus de votante anticipado permanente (permanent advance voting status).
who.quote: Any person having a permanent disability or an illness that has been diagnosed as a permanent illness is hereby authorized to make an application for permanent advance voting status.

cure.en: Sign the outside of your ballot envelope. If the signature doesn't match the one on file, your county election office will contact you to verify it.
cure.es: Firma el exterior del sobre de tu boleta. Si la firma no coincide con la que tienen registrada, la oficina electoral de tu condado se comunicará contigo para verificarla.
cure.quote: When a voter has completed their advance by mail ballot, they must sign the outside of the ballot envelope. That signature is then reviewed with voter registration records. If the signatures do not match, the signature may be challenged, and the county election office will contact the voter to verify the signature.

dropbox.en: Drop your ballot in any drop box in your county, or take it to any polling place in your county. Drop boxes lock when the polls close on Election Day.
dropbox.es: Deja tu boleta en cualquier buzón de entrega de tu condado o llévala a cualquier lugar de votación de tu condado. Los buzones se cierran con llave cuando cierran las urnas el Día de las Elecciones.
dropbox.quote: Voters who vote by mail can return their advance ballot to their county election office by putting it in any of the drop boxes located within their county. Drop boxes are locked at the close of polls on Election Day .

witness.notes: The signature requirement is in mail.cure; no witness or notary rule found.

gear.en: Leave the campaign buttons and stickers at home. Within 250 feet of the entrance to a polling place or advance voting site, you can't wear or hand out labels, signs, posters, stickers or anything else that clearly backs a candidate or a side on a ballot question. A bumper sticker on the car that drives you there is fine.
gear.es: Deja en casa los botones y stickers de campaña. A menos de 250 pies de la entrada de un lugar de votación o de un centro de votación anticipada no puedes llevar ni repartir etiquetas, letreros, carteles, stickers ni nada que apoye claramente a un candidato o una postura sobre una propuesta de la boleta. Una calcomanía en la defensa del carro que te lleva está bien.
gear.quote: including wearing, exhibiting or distributing labels, signs, posters, stickers or other materials that clearly identify a candidate in the election or clearly indicate support or opposition to a question submitted election within any polling place on election day or advance voting site during the time period allowed by law for casting a ballot by advance voting or within a radius of 250 feet from the entrance thereof

phone.en: Kansas's ballot secrecy law covers election workers, who can't reveal your ballot or push you to show it. We found no state law or Secretary of State rule on phones or photos at the polls, so ask a poll worker before you take a photo inside, and keep other voters' ballots out of it.
phone.es: La ley de Kansas sobre el secreto del voto se aplica a los trabajadores electorales, que no pueden revelar tu boleta ni presionarte para que la muestres. No encontramos ninguna ley estatal ni regla de la Secretaría de Estado sobre celulares o fotos en el lugar de votación, así que pregunta a un trabajador electoral antes de tomar una foto adentro, y no saques las boletas de otros votantes.
phone.quote: Unauthorized voting disclosure is, while being charged with any election duty, intentionally: (1) Disclosing or exposing the contents of any ballot, whether cast in a regular or provisional manner, or the name of any voter who cast such ballot ... or (2) inducing or attempting to induce any voter to show how the voter marks or has marked the voter's ballot.

line.en: Stay in line. Everyone in line when the polls close gets to vote.
line.es: Quédate en la fila. Todos los que estén en la fila cuando cierren las urnas pueden votar.
line.quote: Stay in line! All voters who are in line when polling locations close are allowed to vote.

tradition.en: Sedgwick County's 2026 I Voted sticker is a picture of Kansas: a Western Meadowlark, a barn, wheat, a sunflower, the state motto "Ad Astra Per Aspera" and a road across the prairie to the State Capitol. Rylin, a sophomore at Maize South High School, drew it. Penelope, a third grader at Colwich Elementary, drew the county's first Future Voter sticker, an American Buffalo in a field of sunflowers. Community judges picked them in the county's student design contest, from 305 and 163 entries. Voters get them at the polls.
tradition.es: El sticker de I Voted 2026 del condado de Sedgwick es una imagen de Kansas: un pradero occidental (Western Meadowlark), un granero, trigo, un girasol, el lema del estado "Ad Astra Per Aspera" y un camino por la pradera hasta el Capitolio del estado. Lo dibujó Rylin, estudiante de segundo año de Maize South High School. Penelope, estudiante de tercer grado de Colwich Elementary, dibujó el primer sticker de Future Voter del condado: un bisonte americano (American Buffalo) en un campo de girasoles. Un jurado de la comunidad los eligió en el concurso de diseño para estudiantes del condado, entre 305 y 163 propuestas. Los votantes los reciben en su lugar de votación.
tradition.quote: Rylin, a sophomore at Maize South High School, won the contest for the “I Voted” sticker ... including the state bird of Kansas ... the Western Meadowlark, a barn, grain bin, airplane, wheat stalk, sunflower, the state motto ... “Ad Astra Per Aspera,” and a road leading through a prairie to the Kansas State Capitol building. Penelope, a third-grade student at Colwich Elementary, is the winner of the first “Future Voter” sticker contest. Her design features an American Buffalo ... in a field of sunflowers ... wear stickers they get at the polls ... A panel of judges from the community picked the winning artwork from 305 “I Voted” sticker entries and 163 “Future Voter” designs
tradition.notes: Reread Oct 28 (curl, browser UA). The release gives both students' surnames; removed here and in the quote. Johnson County (jocoelection.org, jocogov.org) and Montgomery County (mgcountyks.org) fail the OFFICIAL host check in facts_text.py, and neither office posts 2026 winners on its own site (JoCo's winners appear only on Facebook). Wyandotte County (wycovoteskck.gov) has 2026 contest pages but no 2026 winners.

mail.en: In Sedgwick County, yes. The county election office says voters can wear the 2026 stickers they get at the polls or in a mail ballot, so check your envelope.
mail.es: En el condado de Sedgwick, sí. La oficina electoral del condado dice que los votantes pueden usar los stickers de 2026 que reciben en el lugar de votación o en su boleta por correo, así que revisa tu sobre.
mail.quote: wear stickers they get at the polls or in an advance by mail ballot

provisional.en: You vote a provisional ballot if you don't show a valid photo ID, or if you asked for a mail ballot but vote in person instead. A missing-ID provisional ballot counts once you get your photo ID to the county election office before the county canvass.
provisional.es: Votas con una boleta provisional si no muestras una identificación con foto válida, o si pediste una boleta por correo pero votas en persona. Una boleta provisional por falta de identificación cuenta cuando llevas tu identificación con foto a la oficina electoral del condado antes del escrutinio del condado.
provisional.quote: The voter shall provide a valid form of identification as defined in K.S.A. 25-2908 , and amendments thereto, to the county election officer in person or provide a copy by mail or electronic means before the meeting of the county board of canvassers.

line.en: Stay in line. Everyone in line when the polls close gets to vote.
line.es: Quédate en la fila. Todos los que estén en la fila cuando cierren las urnas pueden votar.
line.quote: Stay in line! All voters who are in line when polling locations close are allowed to vote.

track.en: Track your mail ballot application and your ballot online at kansasvoterinfo.gov, or call your county election office.
track.es: Sigue tu solicitud de boleta por correo y tu boleta en línea en kansasvoterinfo.gov, o llama a la oficina electoral de tu condado.
track.quote: In addition, for the first time, voters can track the status of their advance by mail ballot application and advance by mail ballot online at kansasvoterinfo.gov/ .

notes: Read October 21, 2026 on sos.ks.gov (curl worked), kansasvoterinfo.gov and ksrevisor.gov (K.S.A. 25-1122, 25-2430). EARLY VOTING: states.js (October 14 start, varies by county, ends noon Monday November 2) matches the SOS dates page ('October 14 First day of advance voting... In-person advance voting may begin', 'October 27 In-person advance voting must begin for all counties') and K.S.A. 25-1122(g)(1) ('until no later than 12:00 noon on the day preceding such election'). MAIL RETURN CONFLICT: see dates.mail_return notes; the advance voting page reports a Douglas County injunction (postmarked by Election Day, received by the Friday after) that the Court of Appeals declined to stay for the General Election, and in the next paragraph says all 2026 mail ballots must arrive by close of polls. The lead should decide before any return deadline goes on the page. Mail request deadline: statute only gives 'the Tuesday of the week preceding' the election (reads as October 27); not computed. The drop box and advance voting location lists say 'Will Be Available Soon'; the drop box list is an xlsx download, not opened. Election Day hours stay in faq_text.py (7 a.m. to 7 p.m., counties may run 6 a.m. to 8 p.m.). Oct 28 pass: read sos.ks.gov voter information, FAQ and advance voting pages (mail return wording unchanged: injunction still described, motion to stay denied), K.S.A. 25-106 (Central and Mountain Time hours), 25-1122(f) and (h), 25-2422, and the Sedgwick County sticker release (305 I Voted and 163 Future Voter entries, not 528; winners are students, first name and school only). sticker.tradition moved from the SOS checklist line to the Sedgwick contest.

hours.en: Polling places are open 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Central Time unless your county sets other hours. A county can open as early as 6 a.m. and close as late as 8 p.m. In the western Kansas counties on Mountain Time, the polls are open 6 a.m. to 6 p.m. Mountain Time unless the county sets other hours.
hours.es: Los lugares de votación abren de 7 a. m. a 7 p. m., hora del Centro, salvo que tu condado fije otro horario. Un condado puede abrir desde las 6 a. m. y cerrar hasta las 8 p. m. En los condados del oeste de Kansas que usan la hora de la Montaña, abren de 6 a. m. a 6 p. m., hora de la Montaña, salvo que el condado fije otro horario.
hours.quote: (a) The provisions of this subsection shall apply to all counties in Kansas located in the central time zone. At all national, state, county and township primary and general elections the polls shall open at 7:00 a.m. and close at 7:00 p.m., unless different hours are set and publicly announced by the county election officer. If different hours are set, the polls shall be open at least 12 continuous hours commencing not earlier than 6:00 a.m. and ending not later than 8:00 p.m. ... (b) The provisions of this subsection shall apply to all counties in Kansas located in the mountain time zone. At all national, state, county and township primary and general elections the polls shall open at 6:00 a.m. and close at 6:00 p.m., unless different hours are set and publicly announced by the county election officer.
